findings.title: Life-bearing continuity
findings.claim: The descendants carried with Noah can be heard as life borne inwardly and renewed through rupture; in a barren valley's requested provision, gratitude becomes a visible response to what sustains the line.
findings.mechanism: The focus's حَمَلْنَا carries people with Noah and شَكُورًا describes his gratitude. The exact 31:14 connection depicts a mother carrying a child through successive weakness before weaning; 14:37 places descendants in a valley without cultivation, asks for fruit, and hopes for gratitude. The two external scenes meet the focus's carrying and gratitude, while legacy reader-walk summaries place the line beside the 17:4-8 ruin/restoration sequence and a return of mercy.
findings.reader_payoff: Survival becomes more than a record of passengers: the line can be pictured as life borne onward and sustained, with gratitude as its response.
findings.containment: Gestation and low-input growth remain analogies. The focus still describes people carried with Noah; 14:37 is a request and hope, not a report that a small supply produced a crop. The seedbed image remains exploratory and does not activate a literal seed/scattering sense of ذُرِّيَّةَ. The 17:0/17:4-8 framing is available only through legacy reader-walk summaries.

epistemic.reason: The trusted cross-run claim and exact 31:14/14:37 target Arabic ground the paired relations; the life-bearing synthesis and 17:0/17:4-8 frame remain analogical or legacy-unbound.

findings.title: Carrying as a trust
findings.claim: The focus's physical carrying can take on a wider ethical echo beside the human bearing of a trust, placing responsibility next to Noahic preservation.
findings.mechanism: In 17:3, حَمَلْنَا carries people with Noah. The exact 33:72 connection names al-amānah and then says the human carried it. The shared carrying meets an explicitly entrusted task and extends the focus's transport image toward human responsibility.
findings.reader_payoff: Deliverance and responsibility become adjacent forms of carrying while remaining distinct.
findings.containment: 33:72 is a separate human trust scene. The focus does not say Noah's descendants inherit that trust, and حَمَلْنَا retains its physical sense here.

epistemic.reason: The focus carrier and the supplied 33:72 Arabic make the relation concrete, but the ethical extension remains a contextual analogy.

findings.title: A carried line under threat
findings.claim: The Noahic line is carried forward but remains vulnerable: 17:62 gives Satan an intended assault on progeny, while 17:70 places Adam's children generally inside another scene of carriage and provision.
findings.mechanism: The focus carrier حَمَلْنَا names physical transport with Noah. In 17:70, the carried human community extends across land and sea and receives provision; 17:62 names progeny as the object of Satan's stated intent. Their contact changes the focus from a closed survivor list into an exposed continuity within a wider human carriage.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees survival as continued but vulnerable human continuity, not an assured inherited status.
findings.containment: 17:62 states an intention, not its success. 17:70 broadens the carriage beyond Noah's line; neither verse proves that every descendant is harmed or that the Noahic line is exclusive.

epistemic.reason: The trusted candidate and legacy retrospective are directly grounded by supplied Arabic targets at 17:62 and 17:70; the trust/vulnerability synthesis remains an inference.

findings.reader_payoff: Gratitude remains a human answer to received good, while the wider wording also makes effort something that can be acknowledged in return.
findings.containment: 76:22 and 54:35 are separate contexts, not accounts of Noah. Target morphology and a target-side lexicon are not supplied for 76:22, so the reward/recognition shade remains qualified.

epistemic.reason: The exact target Arabic supports the contact, but the HFT summaries are unbound and no target morphology is supplied; the circuit is a bounded contextual reading.

findings.mechanism: The focus relates descendants to people carried with Noah. findings.title: Grateful service in practice
findings.claim: Noah's servant-and-gratitude description can be heard as an enacted, recurring practice: 34:13 directs work in gratitude and calls grateful servants few, while 25:62 makes alternating night and day occasions for remembrance or gratitude.
findings.mechanism: The focus places عَبْدًا beside شَكُورًا. In 34:13, work is explicitly joined to gratitude and only a few servants are called grateful; 25:62 joins alternating night and day to the desire for remembrance or gratitude. These wider scenes turn the focus's quality into action and recurring opportunity.
findings.reader_payoff: The phrase reads as lived devotion that can be renewed, rather than a static compliment alone.
findings.containment: 34:13 addresses David's household, not Noah, and 25:62 describes an occasion or intention rather than proving Noah's repeated practice. The relation is a parallel, not an identity.

epistemic.reason: Both exact Arabic targets return through the focus's servant/gratitude wording; connection-level source labels are nominations, and target morphology is absent.

findings.title: Gratitude without demand
findings.claim: Noah's gratefulness can remain a willing response rather than a required payment: 76:9 describes people who give while seeking neither recompense nor thanks from those they feed.
findings.mechanism: The focus's شَكُورًا carries gratitude as acknowledgment and response. The exact 76:9 target places feeding for God's sake beside an explicit refusal to seek either recompense or gratitude from recipients; their contact separates grateful response from an obligation imposed by the giver.
findings.reader_payoff: The wider contrast lets gratitude stay freely offered, while generosity remains free of a demand for return.
findings.containment: 76:9 is a separate scene and does not describe Noah or his provisions. It does not say gratitude is wrong or absent, only that these givers do not seek it.

epistemic.reason: The target Arabic supplies the direct shukr contact and refusal of return, while the application to Noah is a contextual inference.
